stories.title: Norris Calls Hungarian Win "Probably My Best Race" — Reigning Champion Finally Clicks

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Lando Norris on his Hungarian GP win: "My pace today was probably some of the best pace I've ever had. The car was beautiful to drive and I felt very confident."

The reigning champion just broke a 10-race drought with what he calls his best race ever.

#F1 #HungarianGP

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Norris won the Hungarian GP without the lead on lap 1.

Piastri led. Piastri retired. Norris survived the chaos, absorbed a chaotic opening ("big snaps, it felt horrible"), and drove his way to a commanding win.

The champ's back. #F1 #LandoNorris

stories.title: Verstappen Exit Clause Is Now Active — McLaren Deal Reported "Imminent"

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
Verstappen's Red Bull exit clause is NOW ACTIVE. He finished outside the top two in the championship at summer break — the exact condition that lets him walk.

ESPN: He and McLaren CEO Zak Brown have spoken. A 3-year deal is "imminent." #F1 #F1Fanrecap

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
Red Bull sources say Verstappen is staying for 2027. ESPN says a McLaren deal is "imminent." Red Bull TP Mekies says a "logical" 2027 lineup decision is coming.

The clause window is open. This summer break decides it. #F1 #MaxVerstappen

stories.title: F1 Returns at Dutch GP — Zandvoort's Farewell, Sprint Weekend, and Verstappen's Home Race

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
F1 returns from summer break August 21-23 at Zandvoort.

It's a Sprint weekend — the first time the circuit has hosted this format. It may also be Zandvoort's LAST-EVER Formula 1 race.

And Verstappen could be racing in front of his home fans in a different car. #F1 #DutchGP
